name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines. Growing up near the old Thomson Road circuit, the roaring sounds of Formula One cars ignited a lifelong passion. He started tinkering with go-karts as a teenager, quickly developing a knack for diagnosing and fixing mechanical issues. After completing his technical education, Tan honed his skills at a local engineering firm, specializing in precision machining.

He joined Carlin Motorsport ten years ago, bringing with him a meticulous approach and an unwavering commitment to quality. Tan believes in preventative maintenance and rigorous testing to ensure the reliability of the team's equipment. Known for his sharp eye for detail, he's often the first to spot potential problems, preventing costly failures on the track. He mentors junior machinists, passing on his extensive knowledge and fostering a culture of excellence within the team. Tan is driven by a desire to see Carlin achieve consistent success, and his dedication is invaluable to the team's performance.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Tan is of average height with a wiry build, a testament to years spent working in the garage.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an almost dangerous point.
Drinks copious amounts of strong kopi (Singaporean coffee) throughout the day.
Has a habit of humming quietly while concentrating on intricate tasks.
